meta.name: obsidian-markdown
meta.description: Create and edit Obsidian Flavored Markdown with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax. Use when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, tags, embeds, or Obsidian notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编辑 Obsidian 专属 Markdown 语法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 写笔记，需要处理 wikilink、callout 等特殊语法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for notes and need to handle wikilinks, callouts, etc.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能按 Obsidian 的规则创建和修改 Markdown 笔记,包括 wikilinks、嵌入、callouts、属性等特殊语法,并产出 Obsidian 能直接使用的格式。
howto.when: 当用户请求创建或修改 Obsidian 笔记(.md 文件),或提到 wikilinks、callouts、frontmatter 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几条笔记用 wikilinks 串起来
say.note: Claude 会生成带 [[笔记名]] 的内部链接。

say.text: 给这篇笔记开头加上属性和标签
把这段文字做成可折叠的 callout
say.note: 输出会用 > [!faq]- 引用块实现折叠。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to create and edit Obsidian Flavored Markdown notes with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax extensions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, or related Obsidian keywords.

say_en.text: Help me link these notes together with wikilinks
say_en.note: Output will use [[note name]] internal links.

say_en.text: Add properties and tags at the top of this note
say_en.note: Claude will write YAML frontmatter metadata.

say_en.text: Turn this paragraph into a collapsible callout
